properties.name: Phase 5, reflow2's half: a hypothesis test reads supported at α, its criteria are locked when its data arrive, α is spent like a budget
properties.rationale:
Choices made where the brief left one: (1) WHAT reflow2 READS is the block the caller passes from the kept record, kept as canonical JSON on the Verification; the server never opens the record, as for any computed check, so it cannot vouch the block is what the file holds. (2) WHEN for the criteria lock: the record carries no time and the core takes no clock, so the lock is taken by the attaching write itself — the α Constraint the record's alpha.source.design_node names (limit, statement), what the check VERIFIES (statement), the Decisions it is GOVERNED_BY (decision, chose), and the record's own test/alternative/α/H0/H1/variance — with last_run_at as the attach date; the time of a change is read from the ChangeEvents that CHANGED the criterion (detected_at, AT_EPOCH). A change made outside the design, or before the lock, is invisible; criteria linked later are listed unlocked. (3) A moved criterion is reported, not folded into the truth (proposed dec:idea-should-a-criterion-changed-after-the-data-move-the-tests-reading). (4) The test's assumptions are premises OF THE TEST (DEPENDS_ON from the check) rather than drawn onto each step, so one objection reaches every step that rests on the test. (5) The argument is `hypothesis_block`, not `hypothesis_test`: the latter made add_verification and reconcile_verification a new mutually confusable pair in find_tools. (6) Holm and Benjamini–Hochberg are named in the recipe and not judged by the rollup (proposed dec:idea-holm-and-benjamini-hochberg-in-the-alpha-budget). Failing first on main 1b6604801: all 10 wire tests failed (add_verification refused the block argument; the recipe test found no Bonferroni). Checks run locally: cargo dev-test (core 1989+257, MCP 823+253, all pass), clippy -D warnings both crates in memory and the MCP crate with RocksDB, fmt, and 16 Python gates (toolsnap, smoke, empty_speaks, refusal_speaks, titles, tool_confusability, replies_are_bounded, a_reply_is_sent_once, skill_lint, discrimination rules, render_skills_and_tools, no real person, changelog fragments, command surface, vocabulary_reach, schema).

properties.subject: system
properties.summary: The three requirements of epoch:planned-p5-hypothesis-tests, with no stamp move (two Verification properties, no new type). add_verification takes `hypothesis_block`, flo2-calc 0.10.0's `hypothesis_test` object from a kept record (schema 10), validated by path before any write. A test that rejects H0 reads "supported at α (p, test, n)" and every claim on it reads `supported` (proof_status, ClaimTruth, statement_reading, rests_on_tests), never shown, proven or holds; a non-rejection reads "not rejected at α", never H0 true. Assumptions are taken-as-given Constraints the check DEPENDS_ON; a test used as an objection contests and never refutes. The first attachment locks the criteria (criteria_at_data); a later change raises criteria_changed_after_data with both values and the ChangeEvents that made it. Recording draws CONSTRAINS from the α Constraint the record names (its α as contribution on a budget), so budget_report sums a family; a test run above its share reads unknown. Recipe: design-a-proof §4a.
